Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that George Sherman died in 2011. In Step 9, the WebSurfer successfully retrieved the correct death date (March 15, 1991) from multiple credible sources (Wikipedia, Find a Grave, IMDb). The Planner failed to verify this data before proceeding to the final comparison, instead hallucinating a death year of 2011. This error led to the incorrect conclusion that B. S. Ranga (died 2010) died after George Sherman, whereas in reality, George Sherman died in 1991, making him the director who died first.
